design.text: The isolated routing design is ready for review. Measured convergence and traffic disruption require a dedicated comparative experiment runner.

BGP.spine-1:
frr defaults traditional
hostname spine-1
!
router bgp 65000
 bgp router-id 10.219.1.1
 timers bgp 1 4
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 10.217.11.2 remote-as 65101
 neighbor 10.217.12.2 remote-as 65102
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  maximum-paths 2
 exit-address-family
exit

plain: Several equal-cost paths between your leaves are likely due to the network design, where multiple paths are used to distribute traffic efficiently across the network. This is common in large-scale networks to ensure redundancy and load balancing. The equal-cost paths are likely established through BGP sessions, which are used to exchange routing information between the routers.
